The Yakut (Sakha) language is primarily spoken in the **Sakha Republic** (also known as Sakha Krai) [[E1]].

According to the official list of office-holders for the Head of the Sakha Republic, **Aysen Nikolayev** is the incumbent leader, having been elected in 2018 and with the most recent election mentioned in the source being in 2023 [[E3]].
